apps.message:
feat(listing): validate listing pull requests and comment the report

## Intent

Step 9 of the plan (apps#3): a pull request that adds or changes a catalog entry is checked against the deployed app. The creator's assistant gets one comment per pull request that names each finding and its fix, and can run the same check locally.

## Key changes

- `npm run listing -- entries/<id>.yaml` runs `lernapps check --entry` of @lernapps/tooling for each entry, adds the catalog's rule that fitness.checked may be true only while the check passes, writes the reports and prints the results comment.
- CI runs the same command read-only and without secrets. A second workflow runs from main, renders the comment from the reports as data and keeps one comment per pull request up to date, also once the check passes.
- llms.txt points assistants to the command and the comment; the tests run in the Pages workflow.
- End-to-end tests run the command on fixture entries against a fixture app on 127.0.0.1: a broken topic link fails with the fix, the fixed entry passes, a wrong storage value and checked: true on a failing check fail, an unreachable app fails, and a hostile report renders as plain text.

## Dependencies and side effects

- @lernapps/tooling becomes a development dependency, pinned to a commit of its main.
